what: Once open, big accent-colored words and photo cuts alternate on a black stage, cutting faster and faster (420ms → 60ms). During the tail after the last big word, the top and bottom bands close by (1−cos)/2, then after .12s they split up and down over .9s to reveal the page — a trailer-like loading sequence.

options.speed: Speed up cut length by this multiplier (default 1). 2 means twice as fast.
options.delay: Time until splitting after the band fully closes (sec), default 0.12
options.[data-fx-part=cut]: One cut (child, in order). If it holds only text it is a word cut — fitted within .9 width and .76 height. If a photo or placeholder is inserted, it covers the screen
options.data-ms: Length per cut (ms). If omitted, the original table 420·360·310·270·230·200·170·150·190·110·90·80·70, then 60
options.data-look: Write cut types separated by spaces — full (full screen width, the strip closes after this cut) · accent (stage-color text on accent background) · flip (mirror left-right) · invert (invert)
options.--fx-stage: Stage and band color (via style), default var(--kf-contrast-bg)
options.fx:done: When all bands are gone, the element fires this event and hides
